category_title: Students with intellectual disabilities who exhibit disruptive behaviors (hitting, making sounds, damaging property)
minimal_context: The student is sitting alone in the classroom and is expected to replicate letters for a lettering study.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here are your lettering studies. Please try to replicate these letters on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits alone at the desk and does not react to the materials.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think? You can pick up your pencil now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying, just copy the letters.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Does not react to the instruction and continues to be completely unresponsive to the interaction with the tutor.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here are your lettering studies. Please try to replicate these letters on your paper.

STUDENT: (Sits alone at the desk and does not react to the materials.)

TUTOR: What do you think? You can pick up your pencil now.

STUDENT: (Remains unresponsive to the interaction.)

TUTOR: Keep trying, just copy the letters.

STUDENT: (Does not react to the instruction and continues to be completely unresponsive to the interaction with the tutor.)

task.content: do lettering studies suitable for him and try to make him replicate these

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: does not react to many things and is often unresponsive

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: tears and scribbles on others’ books and disturbed them all the time
